title: Loving Others
definition: Loving others is the believer's call to seek the good of neighbors, enemies, brothers, sisters, and the needy according to the love of Christ.
summary: Christian love is not mere emotion. It serves, sacrifices, forgives, speaks truth, and acts for another's good.
christFocus: Christ loved His people sacrificially and commands them to love one another.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Christian love is not mere emotion. It serves, sacrifices, forgives, speaks truth, and acts for another's good.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
